title: A1 Writing Quiz 4 — Work, Family & Everyday Activities

questions.question: Choose the correct word order.
questions.explanation: Subject + verb + object + time: 'I drink tea every morning.'

questions.question: Choose the correct word order.
options: My uncle works at a hospital.
My uncle at a hospital works.
Works my uncle at a hospital.
At a hospital my uncle works.
questions.explanation: Subject + verb + place: 'My uncle works at a hospital.'

questions.question: Choose the correct word order.
questions.explanation: Subject + verb + object: 'She bought a new laptop.'

questions.question: Choose the correct question word order.
options: How many brothers you have do?
How many brothers do you have?
Do how many brothers you have?
You how many brothers do have?
questions.explanation: Wh-phrase + auxiliary + subject + verb: 'How many brothers do you have?'

questions.question: Which sentence uses capital letters correctly?
options: my father works at academor training center.
My father works at Academor Training Center.
My Father Works At Academor training center.
my father Works at Academor Training center.
questions.explanation: Institution names (Academor Training Center) are proper nouns and must be capitalized.

questions.question: Choose the correctly capitalized sentence.
questions.explanation: Days of the week (Friday) are proper nouns and always capitalized.

questions.question: Which sentence has correct punctuation?
questions.explanation: A simple statement ends with a full stop: 'I have a black cat.'

questions.question: Which sentence has correct punctuation?
options: What time does the class start.
What time does the class start
What time does the class start?
What time does the class start!
questions.explanation: A question ends with a question mark: 'What time does the class start?'

questions.question: Choose the sentence with correct commas.
options: I can speak Azerbaijani English and Russian.
I can speak Azerbaijani, English and Russian.
I can speak, Azerbaijani English, and Russian.
I can speak Azerbaijani, English, and, Russian.
questions.explanation: Use commas to separate items in a list: 'Azerbaijani, English and Russian.'

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: 'We're' is the contraction of 'we are'.

questions.question: My father ___ to work by car.
questions.explanation: Present simple with 'father' (he) takes -es: 'goes'.

questions.question: I ___ my keys this morning.
questions.explanation: 'This morning' (finished time) signals past simple; irregular past of 'lose' is 'lost'.

questions.question: Listen! The birds ___ outside.
questions.explanation: 'Listen!' signals an action happening now → present continuous: 'are singing'.

questions.question: Choose the sentence that correctly uses 'and'.
options: I clean my room and I do my homework.
I clean my room and but homework.
I clean my room, and, homework.
questions.explanation: 'And' joins two similar actions: 'I clean my room and I do my homework.'

questions.question: Choose the sentence that correctly uses 'but'.
options: The film was long but interesting.
The film was long and but interesting.
But the film was long interesting.
The film, interesting but was long.
questions.explanation: 'But' shows contrast: 'The film was long but interesting.'

questions.question: Choose the sentence that correctly uses 'so'.
options: I was hungry, so I made a sandwich.
So I was hungry I made a sandwich.
I was hungry I made so a sandwich.
So, made I a sandwich hungry was.
questions.explanation: 'So' introduces a result: 'I was hungry, so I made a sandwich.'

questions.question: The pharmacy is ___ the corner.
questions.explanation: We use 'on' with 'corner': 'on the corner.'

questions.question: I was born ___ 2005.
questions.explanation: 'In' is used with years: 'in 2005.'

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: He is the a hour late.
questions.explanation: 'Hour' begins with a silent 'h', so its sound is a vowel sound → 'an hour.'

questions.question: Which is the correct way to start a message to your teacher?
questions.explanation: 'Dear Mrs. [Surname],' is a respectful, semi-formal opening suitable for a teacher.

questions.question: Which is the correct way to end a message to your teacher?
questions.explanation: 'Best wishes,' is a polite, semi-formal closing suitable for a teacher.

questions.question: Which is the correct way to start a formal complaint letter to a company?
questions.explanation: 'Dear Sir/Madam,' is the standard formal opening when writing to a company.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly combines 'I have a dog.' and 'I have a cat.'?
options: I have a dog but I have a cat.
I have a dog and a cat.
I have a dog, I have a cat.
I dog and cat have a a.
questions.explanation: Two related items can be joined simply: 'I have a dog and a cat.'

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: She wore a leather old jacket.
She wore an old leather jacket.
She wore old a leather jacket.
She wore a jacket old leather.
questions.explanation: Age usually comes before material: 'an old leather jacket.'

questions.question: Which sentence correctly shows joy?
questions.explanation: An exclamation mark shows strong emotion: 'We won the game!'

questions.question: ___ some apples in the basket.
questions.explanation: 'Some apples' is plural → 'There are'.

questions.question: Those are ___ toys. (belong to the children)
questions.explanation: 'Children' is already plural (irregular), so add 's: "children's toys".

questions.question: Choose the sentence that correctly uses sequencing words.
options: First, I brush my teeth. Then, I get dressed.
First I brush teeth then get dressed then.
Get dressed first then brush I teeth.
Then first, I brush teeth get I dressed.
questions.explanation: Sequencing words like 'First,' and 'Then,' organize steps clearly with commas.

questions.question: My parents ___ from Ganja.
questions.explanation: 'My parents' is plural → 'are'.

questions.question: Choose the correct question.
options: What you do on weekends do?
What do you do on weekends?
Do what you do on weekends?
questions.explanation: Wh-word + auxiliary + subject + verb: 'What do you do on weekends?'
